name: Google Play Login
description: Automates Google account sign-in through the Google Play Store app on Android with Appium, and verifies that the active/signed-in account matches the requested email.

cli.name: --manualWaitSeconds
cli.description: Seconds to wait while the user completes 2FA, CAPTCHA, or security prompts on the device.

cli.name: --stepDelayMs
cli.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after each scripted pause/click/type step.

cli.name: --accountsFile
cli.description: Path to a JSON array of accounts for multi-device login. Each item can include udid, email, and password.

cli.name: --accounts
cli.description: Inline multi-device accounts separated by semicolon, using udid|email|password or email|password.

cli.name: --dryRun
cli.description: Validate multi-device account mapping without starting login sessions.

limitations: If Play Store is already signed in with a different account, the script tries to open Add another account.
Google may require manual 2FA, CAPTCHA, passkey, or phone confirmation.
The script does not bypass Google security checks.
UI text and resource IDs may vary by Android, Play Store, Google Play services, and language version.
